messages:
maria.k: quick thought — instead of immediately failing over when a model variant trips its circuit breaker, what if we add a short 'handshake' probe lane that slowly probes the variant+region to validate it's healthy before routing full traffic?
kevin_w: proto idea: when cb trips for variant V, open a handshake lane with handshake_pct starting at 5%. if success criteria met, ramp 5->50%. avoids full flip-flop. handshake uses reduced batch size + KV warmup.
aditya: how do we define success? propose: p95_latency_ms <= tier_latency_slo && error_rate <= cb_error_rate over a 5m rolling window. must be tenant-scoped.
tara: console/ux: show handshake state per rollout (Pending -> Probing -> Healthy -> Rejected). surface metrics: handshake.start, handshake.attempt, handshake.success, handshake.fail. show a tiny sparkline + progress bar. @maria.k we should default to opt-in.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: triggered canary for model rwd-7b-8q in us-west with handshake_pct=10% (rollout_id: r-20260320-01) :rocket:
kevin_w: also tie handshake capacity to tier: gold=30%, silver=10%, bronze=0. and have fallback priority list (same-region variant -> regional-variant -> lower-capacity CPU fallback).
lucas: concern: handshake path can add kernel cold-start latency if variant isn't warmed. suggest pre-warm scheduling + prefer same-az instances. circuit-breaker backoff should be exponential with max cap.
aditya: suggested CB config fields (draft):
```
cb_error_rate: 0.02
sliding_window_sec: 300
min_consecutive_failures: 3
backoff_initial_ms: 1000
backoff_max_ms: 60000
handshake_pct: 5
handshake_ramp_steps: [5,20,50]
```
maria.k: example high-level policy DSL (very rough):
```yaml
policy:
  tier: gold
  latency_slo_ms: 200
  availability_slo: 0.999
  circuit_breaker:
    error_rate: 0.02
    window: 300
    backoff: exp
  handshake:
    enabled: true
    start_pct: 5
    ramp: [5,20,50]
    success_criteria:
      p95_ms: <= latency_slo_ms
      error_rate: <= 0.01
```
tara: UX notes: default should be conservative (handshake disabled for free tier). add a "simulate-handshake" toggle that runs probes against a mirror traffic stream so infra teams can preview. visuals should include rollout_id, tenant_id, and metric deltas.
kevin_w: observability: emit events with tags: tenant_id, rollout_id, variant, region, handshake_phase. add a gauge for current_handshake_pct per variant. also synthetic canary traffic injection for validation.
aditya: agree. Also we need a clear telemetry naming scheme so SLO dashboards can slice by tenant/tier/variant. e.g. redwood.handshake.latency.p95, redwood.handshake.error_rate.
maria.k: action items: 1) @aditya draft CB fields + thresholds 2) @kevin_w runtime handshake sketch + perf cost estimate 3) @tara console mocks + events list 4) @lucas pre-warm strategy writeup. i'll draft RFC after those. :memo: 
aditya: ack — will have draft in ~48h.
ops-bot: incident-bot: note — us-west CB trips up 2% in last hour, tagging this thread for visibility.
lucas: +1 on pre-warm doc, will include AZ-aware placement and GPU kernel warm paths.
maria.k: thanks everyone — will add meeting invite if needed to sync next week. :thumbsup:
